name: Common Financial Instrument Attributes 12
definition: Tangible items of value to a business.

SecurityStatus.name: Security Status
SecurityStatus.definition: Specifies the status of the security within its lifecycle.

ISOSecurityShortName.name: ISO Security Short Name
ISOSecurityShortName.definition: Short name of the security expressed as ISO 18773/18774.

NameValidFrom.name: Name Valid From
NameValidFrom.definition: Defines the date since when the name of the security is valid.

DenominationCurrency.name: Denomination Currency
DenominationCurrency.definition: Currency in which a security is issued or redenominated.

CertificateNumber.name: Certificate Number
CertificateNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a certificate assigned by the issuer.

ContractVersionNumber.name: Contract Version Number
ContractVersionNumber.definition: Version number assigned to the contract associated with the security.

CouponAttachedNumber.name: Coupon Attached Number
CouponAttachedNumber.definition: Number of the coupon attached to the physical security.

TaxLotNumber.name: Tax Lot Number
TaxLotNumber.definition: Identification, for tax purposes, of a lot of identical securities that are bought at a certain date and at a certain price.

PoolNumber.name: Pool Number
PoolNumber.definition: Number identifying a group of underlying assets assigned by the issuer of a factored security.

CoveredIndicator.name: Covered Indicator
CoveredIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the derivative product is covered or not by an underlying financial instrument position.

LegalRestrictions.name: Legal Restrictions
LegalRestrictions.definition: Specifies the regulatory restrictions applicable to a security.

PositionLimit.name: Position Limit
PositionLimit.definition: Position limits are created for the purpose of maintaining stable and fair markets. Contracts held by one individual investor with different brokers may be combined in order to gauge accurately the level of control held by one party. ||Each option and futures contract will have varying position limits.

NearTermPositionLimit.name: Near Term Position Limit
NearTermPositionLimit.definition: Near-term position limit for the instrument.

ListingDate.name: Listing Date
ListingDate.definition: Original Date/time at which the security is listed at the specific exchange or trading venue.

RecordDate.name: Record Date
RecordDate.definition: Date/time at which positions are struck to note which parties are entitled to receive the entitlement to a corporate event or vote at a meeting.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date on which a privilege expires.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Reason for which money is raised through the issuance of a security.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Information allowing the classification of a financial instrument, for example, with its ISO CFI (Classification of Financial Instrument) or product type.

Issuance.name: Issuance
Issuance.definition: Details regarding the issuance of an asset.

TradingMarket.name: Trading Market
TradingMarket.definition: Market(s) on which the security is traded.

SpreadAndBenchmarkCurve.name: Spread And Benchmark Curve
SpreadAndBenchmarkCurve.definition: Indicates the spread to benchmark details of an indication of interest.

FungibleIndicator.name: Fungible Indicator
FungibleIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a security is interchangeable, ie, the security is allowed to be replaced by another security, without loss of value.

Confidential.name: Confidential
Confidential.definition: Indicates whether the details of the security are to be made available to the market, or kept private between ICSDs and agency network.

PrivatePlacement.name: Private Placement
PrivatePlacement.definition: The sale of securities directly to private persons, institutional investors, or both outside a public offering. Such non-public deals (often without a publicly available prospectus) closing through the ICSDs are placed directly with investors.

ConvertibleIndicator.name: Convertible Indicator
ConvertibleIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the investor or the issuer has a conversion option.

ConversionPeriod.name: Conversion Period
ConversionPeriod.definition: Period during which a convertible security may be converted according to the terms of the issue.

ConversionRatioNumerator.name: Conversion Ratio Numerator
ConversionRatioNumerator.definition: Number of target securities for the conversion.

ConversionRatioDenominator.name: Conversion Ratio Denominator
ConversionRatioDenominator.definition: Number of held securities for the conversion.

TradingMethod.name: Trading Method
TradingMethod.definition: Indicates whether the notional amount value is to be traded in either an amount or in units.

TEFRARule.name: TEFRA Rule
TEFRARule.definition: Indicates the TEFRA rule under which the security is issued.

Class.name: Class
Class.definition: Identifier that links multiple security classes.

WithholdingTaxRegime.name: Withholding Tax Regime
WithholdingTaxRegime.definition: Amount or percentage of a cash distribution that will be withheld by a tax authority.

PaymentStatus.name: Payment Status
PaymentStatus.definition: Status of payment of a security at a particular time.

InitialPhysicalForm.name: Initial Physical Form
InitialPhysicalForm.definition: Indicates the physical form of the securities on the closing date.

AfterExchangePhysicalForm.name: After Exchange Physical Form
AfterExchangePhysicalForm.definition: Indicates the physical form of the securities after the exchange of the initial certificate issued on the closing date.

CommonSafekeeper.name: Common Safekeeper
CommonSafekeeper.definition: Entity appointed by the ICSDs to provide safekeeping for securities in new global note (NGN) form.

RedemptionType.name: Redemption Type
RedemptionType.definition: Indicates the type of redemption at maturity.

RedemptionPaymentCurrency.name: Redemption Payment Currency
RedemptionPaymentCurrency.definition: ISO currency for the payment of the cash proceeds.

Restriction.name: Restriction
Restriction.definition: Regulatory restriction(s) linked to the security.

SettlementInformation.name: Settlement Information
SettlementInformation.definition: Settlement of the securities in a securities transaction, that is, the instruction to deliver or receive securities, involving the payment of an amount of money or not.

FinancialInstrumentForm.name: Financial Instrument Form
FinancialInstrumentForm.definition: Indicates the form of the financial Instrument.

ContactName.name: Contact Name
ContactName.definition: Details (name, e-mail address and/or telephone number) of the person requesting the allocation of the ISIN used as a point of reference in case further clarifications are required.

LeadManager.name: Lead Manager
LeadManager.definition: Entity appointed by the issuer to structure and lead the placement of a syndicated issue.

PrincipalPayingAgent.name: Principal Paying Agent
PrincipalPayingAgent.definition: Main party appointed to distribute payment or securities on behalf of the issuer.

PayingAgent.name: Paying Agent
PayingAgent.definition: Additional party appointed to distribute payment or securities on behalf of the issuer.

Depository.name: Depository
Depository.definition: Entity appointed by the relevant clearing system as a depository for instruments issued in global or definitive form. The depository keeps the securities for safekeeping purposes on behalf of the clearing system(s).

UnderlyingRisk.name: Underlying Risk
UnderlyingRisk.definition: Entity(ies), asset(s) or security(ies) on which the credit responsibility lies as identified in the documentation.
